messages:
reza: Late check-in — pushed a small change to rate limiter config in canary (PR #7489). Saw 99p token latency jump from ~180ms -> ~420ms during a short burst after a batching heuristic tweak. Rolling back batching for now.

maria: Thanks — do you have traces or request ids to look at? Any sign it correlates with auth or backend slowness?

reza: Got a trace: x-request-id=abc123. It shows the auth proxy returning intermittent 503s then retries piling up at the gateway. I temporarily set `max_retries: 1` on the auth proxy for the canary.

sam: Can we also disable automatic batching in the canary so we isolate rate vs batch effects?

reza: Already did a quick patch: `batch_size: 1` in canary config and redeployed. Deploy logs look clean.

deploy-bot: canary deploy for service/api-gateway (rev 7f8a) completed — 3/3 health checks passed.

lia: I pushed a small auth timeout tweak to staging (auth-proxy timeout -> 800ms). Can someone eyeball staging logs for any new 800ms timeouts?

maria: I'll scan the logs now and post a summary. Also can we open a follow-up to consider short-lived auth caching on the gateway? auth retries are amplifying bursts.

noah: reza — can you add a note in the incident template: "auth retries can amplify latency under burst"? Helps future triage.

reza: Done — created issue #3120 and added the note in the PR description. Current blocker: want SRE opinion whether to change global retry policy or restrict to canaries. Today I'll finish the perf harness for routing-policy combos and verify rate-limit backpressure behavior.

sam: happy to pair on the harness later today, ping me when you're ready. :thumbsup: 

maria: summary from logs: staging auth 503s spiked at 02:17 UTC, correlated with a client-side burst from a test job. No persistent errors after rollback. Will follow up with dashboards.

reza: great, thanks. I'll keep the canary at batch_size=1 until we validate.

lia: update — added a quick dashboard tile for auth downstream latency. Sharing link in #monitoring after I finish wiring. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
